text: Two parts. Practise in small groups by sector: case interviews for Consulting, technical questions for Finance and VC, and product cases for Tech and Product. text: Networking for founders and collaborators: find a co-founder, or offer your skills (marketing, coding or anything else). Colour-coded name tags help you find the right people, plus coffee, croissants and prizes. Run by the Enterprise Lab: register on their page by 25 November.
